create_contact_qr_code.description: Turn someone's contact details into a QR code that a phone offers to save straight to its address book. The one for a business card, an email signature or a conference badge. No account or API key required.
create_contact_qr_code.display_str_template: Create a contact QR code for {0}.
create_contact_qr_code.name: create_contact_qr_code

parameters.description: Optional. Their first name. Fill in at least one of first name, last name or company.
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: Optional. Their family name.
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Optional. Include the country code so the number dials from anywhere.
parameters.name: phone

parameters.description: Optional. Their email address. Separate several with commas.
parameters.name: emails

parameters.description: Optional. Where they work.
parameters.name: company

parameters.description: Optional. Their role.
parameters.name: job_title

parameters.description: Optional. A postal address, written as one line.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Optional. A web address to save with the contact. Separate several with commas.
parameters.name: websites

parameters.description: How many pixels across the code is, between 100 and 2048. A frame and caption add to this.
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: The colour of the code itself, as a hex colour. It has to be clearly darker than the background or scanners will not read it.
parameters.name: code_color

parameters.description: The colour behind the code, as a hex colour. Keep it light so the code stands out.
parameters.name: background_color

parameters.description: The shape of the small squares that make up the code.
parameters.name: dot_style

parameters.description: The shape of the three large squares in the code's corners.
parameters.name: corner_style

parameters.description: The shape of the solid centre inside each corner square.
parameters.name: corner_dot_style

parameters.description: A plain background, or one that blends the background colour into a second colour.
parameters.name: background_style

parameters.description: The colour the background blends into, as a hex colour. Keep it light too, so the whole code stays readable.
parameters.name: gradient_color

parameters.description: A border drawn around the code.
parameters.name: frame_style

parameters.description: The colour of the frame and of the band a caption sits on, as a hex colour.
parameters.name: frame_color

parameters.description: Where the caption goes, if there is one.
parameters.name: caption_position

parameters.description: The typeface for the caption, if there is one.
parameters.name: caption_font

parameters.description: The colour of the caption's letters, as a hex colour. It sits on the frame colour, so pick one that stands out against it.
parameters.name: caption_color

parameters.description: Optional. An image to place in the middle of the code: upload one, paste a link to one, or use a file from an earlier step. The code is made sturdier automatically so it still scans.

parameters.description: How much of the code the logo covers, if there is one.

description: Make styled QR codes with TheQRCode.io: a link, any text, a ready-written email, a Wi-Fi code that joins the network when a guest scans it, or a contact card a phone saves to its address book. Choose the colours, the shape of the dots and corners, a gradient background, a frame with a caption such as SCAN ME, and put your logo in the middle. Each code is saved as a PNG for later steps and comes with a link to share it. No account or API key required.
